project.name: Anima Web
project.summary: Production web and provisioning surface currently presenting the Spiron AI-agent workforce product, owning the Next.js marketing/provisioning app, Telegram webhook ingress, instance APIs, database schema, Docker build input, and push-triggered platform redeploy workflow.
goals: Present and operate the public web surface for the Spiron/Anima agent product.
Own instance registration, admin instance provisioning, stats, and Telegram webhook ingress implemented in this web app.
Keep web/provisioning behavior separate from the underlying agent runtime and platform infrastructure.
nonGoals: Do not own the Spiron agent runtime, sub-agent execution engine, memory system, or platform compute substrate.
Do not own Sylphx Platform internals, central CI runners, enterprise release bots, or organization-wide delivery policy.
Do not add product-runtime internals to the web/provisioning boundary.

owns.name: anima-web-surface
owns.description: Next.js public web application, marketing surface, public stats route, and product presentation for the Spiron/Anima agent product.

owns.name: anima-provisioning-api
owns.description: Instance registration, admin instance provisioning, Telegram webhook ingress, and related database schema in this web app.

owns.name: anima-web-delivery
owns.description: Docker build input and push-triggered platform redeploy workflow for the web/provisioning service.

doesNotOwn: Spiron agent runtime, sub-agent execution engine, semantic memory system, or platform compute substrate.
Sylphx Platform internals, runner fleet, reusable deployment infrastructure, organization-wide rulesets, or enterprise release bot implementation.
Customer-specific agent behavior or agent workflow logic outside the web/provisioning boundary.

allowedDependencies.surface: published agent product/runtime APIs or deployment status only
public platform deploy, database, runtime, and webhook support surfaces only
project manifest schema, standards, and rollout audit

forbiddenCouplings: Do not implement or patch the Spiron agent runtime, memory engine, or execution substrate in this web repository.
Do not reach into Sylphx Platform internals instead of public platform surfaces.
Do not store webhook secrets, platform API tokens, or environment-specific credentials in source.
Do not treat source revert as sufficient recovery for webhook ingress, instance provisioning, database migrations, or deployed service side effects.

delivery.deployPath: .github/workflows/ci.yml triggers a Sylphx Platform API redeploy on main using PLATFORM_APP_ID and PLATFORM_API_TOKEN. Dockerfile defines the web image. No PR CI or required PR status context is currently configured.
delivery.productionProof: Behavior changes require build validation, migration proof for schema changes, platform deploy/readback, and smoke evidence for affected public, webhook, or provisioning routes. Manifest-only changes are proven by the doctrine project-control audit.

commercial.decisionHome: docs/adr/ for product positioning, pricing, packaging, roadmap, and provisioning-commercial decisions.
commercial.pricingSourceOfTruth: No repo-local pricing SSOT is declared; future pricing must use the owning Spiron/Anima or billing product source of truth.
commercial.metricsSourceOfTruth: No repo-local funnel or revenue metrics SSOT is declared; future commercial decisions must cite the owning analytics source.
guardrails: No pricing, packaging, product-positioning, or paid provisioning change without a Commercial ADR.
Do not implement Spiron runtime commercial behavior in the web/provisioning boundary.
Webhook, provisioning, and instance side effects require forward-only recovery planning and smoke evidence.

gaps.description: Repository has a push-triggered deployment workflow but no pull-request CI gate for web, database, or provisioning changes.
Repository has not adopted central ADR-29 stable admission fan-in contexts.
gaps.target: Central CI runner and admission control plane

gaps.description: The boundary between Anima Web provisioning and the Spiron agent runtime is documented but not yet enforced by generated contracts or stable release-evidence checks.
